confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader markdown, pypdf fallback text, rendered methods/figure pages, extracted Figure 1 image, Elsevier supplement DOCX/text, DOI/Crossref/PMC source routes, and arithmetic checks were reviewed. The paper reports enough Segment 1-4 information to recreate the main front-space and back-space looming profiles, plus the supplemental front-space receding control. Remaining uncertainty concerns exact sound waveform/source, gain/SPL law, speaker model, and full audio-file duration.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The main experiments can be recreated as two 16-speaker-array trunk PPS profiles: front looming with chest vibration and back looming with back vibration, each under synchronous/asynchronous FBI blocks. A supplemental front-space receding control is also reconstructable at the same timing/count level. Exact audio asset class, source file, SPL/gain envelope, speaker model, and full sound offset remain approximations.

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Participants stood upright wearing an HMD and viewed a virtual body in front. Figure 1 and methods indicate the physical body faced the virtual body/front-space; no block-wise participant rotation is reported.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Two physical arrays of 8 speakers each were placed beside the body, one left and one right, 50 cm from midline. Four speakers per side were in front-space and four per side in back-space, extending from 100 cm front to 100 cm back.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: Experiment 1 tests front-space sounds looming toward the chest; Experiment 2 tests back-space sounds looming toward the back. The supplement adds a front-space receding control. Sounds were perceived from the center between the arrays.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Precision MicroDrives vibration motor at stern level: chest in Experiment 1 and back in Experiment 2; supplemental receding control used chest stimulation.
orientation_ledger.movement_implementation: Apparent motion is implemented by the loudspeaker arrays/dynamic auditory presentation; the exact speaker-switching or gain law is not reported. HMD/camera equipment belongs to the FBI manipulation, not the auditory renderer.
orientation_ledger.evidence_class: Main-text methods, Figure 1 caption/image, rendered PDF page 3, supplement DOCX localization and receding-control methods, and fallback pypdf page snippets.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-8 for apparatus, speaker arrays, Figure 1 geometry, PPS timing, baseline/catch rules, procedure, counts, analyses, and supplemental-control references.
Used as the primary extracted-text map for semantic searches over stimulus reconstruction, geometry, timing/SOA, sequence/intermixing, baseline/catch/counts, and supplement references.
Visual inspection of Figure 1 to confirm virtual body in front, physical body orientation, side loudspeaker arrays, front-space and back-space panels, and chest/back tactile anchors.
Elsevier supplement downloaded from the article CDN; checked sound-localization control and front-space receding-sound control methods/results.
Searched sound, localization, receding, loudspeaker, stimuli, SOA, velocity, waveform/noise/tone, catch, baseline, and trial-count terms.
Printed targeted page snippets for loudspeakers, PPS measurement, procedure, counts, baseline/catch, supplement references, receding control, and response/scoring rules.
Temporary rendered pages were visually checked for Figure 1, caption text, PPS measurement, and procedure/counts. Page images were not committed.
Direct Elsevier supplement URL was checked and downloaded; Crossref and PMC routes were also checked, with PMC OA reporting the article is not open-access via that API.

review_attempts.result: Mapped automated candidate fields and identified the main methods pages for speaker layout, 75 cm/s looming, T1-T6 SOAs, baseline/catch rows, and block counts.
Confirmed the two side 8-speaker arrays, front/back body-relative looming paths, 75 cm/s main-task speed, 190-1140 ms timing range, and missing waveform/gain details.
Inspected Figure 1 and rendered page 3; recorded participant facing, virtual-body/front direction, side loudspeaker arrays, front/back mapping, tactile anchors, and viewpoint caveat.
Separated synchronous/asynchronous FBI blocks from intermingled PPS task trials and recorded the fixed three-trial plus 10 s FBI-only cycle.
Confirmed 100 ms chest/back vibration, T1-T6 190 ms increments, D6-to-D1 looming mapping, tactile-only D1/D6 baselines, and fastest-baseline analysis rule.
Confirmed per-stroking-block counts: 72 PPS trials, 24 baseline trials, and 12 auditory-only catch trials, giving 108 trials per block and 216 per experiment participant.
Downloaded Elsevier mmc1 DOCX, extracted text, and checked PMC/Crossref/DOI routes. Supplement adds localization and receding-control methods but no waveform/source/gain files.
Checked SOA x speed distance mapping, row x repetition totals, main-task 75 cm/s vs supplement localization 35 cm/s, and kept exact full sound duration/gain law unresolved.

stimulus_type.evidence_note: The sources say looming/receding sound but do not identify noise, tone, file, waveform, or sound class.

source_provenance.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3 and Appendix A; supplement searched
source_provenance.evidence_note: No original WAV, script, generator, software, or seed/source provenance was found.

trajectory_count.value: Two main body-relative looming profiles: Experiment 1 front-space toward chest and Experiment 2 back-space toward back. Supplement adds one front-space receding control profile.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF p.3, PPS measurement; supplement Receding Methods
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Localization control is a validation task, not a separate main PPS profile.

trajectory_path.value: Participants stood midway between two left/right 8-speaker arrays, each 50 cm from midline, spanning 100 cm front to 100 cm back. Sounds were perceived centrally; Exp. 1 used front-space approach and Exp. 2 back-space approach.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Figure 1 shows virtual body in front and side arrays beside the physical body.

stimulus_duration.value: Task-relevant auditory sampling spans T1-T6 from 190 ms to 1.14 s after sound onset; the full sound file duration/offset is not separately reported.
stimulus_duration.page_or_section: PDF p.3; supplement Peripersonal Space Measurement
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Use 1.14 s as the minimum task-critical segment; do not treat it as a fully reported audio-file length.

stimulus_speed.value: Main PPS looming sounds approached at 75 cm/s; supplemental front-space receding sounds also used 75 cm/sec. The supplement localization control separately used 35 cm/s for a full front-to-back validation.
stimulus_speed.page_or_section: PDF p.3; supplement Localization and Receding Methods
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Do not substitute the localization-control 35 cm/s for the main PPS task.

auditory_conditions.value: Main experiments use task-irrelevant looming sounds in front-space or back-space while synchronous/asynchronous FBI stroking is blocked. Supplement tests front-space receding sounds as an attention-control profile.
auditory_conditions.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3 and p.8; supplement Receding Methods
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Synchronous/asynchronous is a visuo-tactile FBI manipulation, not an auditory waveform condition.

gain_envelope.evidence_note: No SPL, attenuation, cross-fade, speaker-switch, or gain law is reported.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Auditory apparatus used two physical 8-speaker arrays beside the chest, one right and one left, 50 cm from midline. FBI apparatus used Oculus Rift SDK HMD and Logitech C270 cameras.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Speaker model is not reported; HMD/cameras are for FBI, not auditory rendering.

trial_rows_families.value: PPS audio-tactile trials, tactile-only baseline trials, auditory-only catch trials, and ongoing visuo-tactile FBI stroking/questionnaire blocks.
trial_rows_families.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, PPS measurement and Procedure
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: Baseline and catch rows are included in each stroking-condition block.

condition_intermixing.value: Visuo-tactile FBI stimulation was intermingled with audio-tactile PPS trials. Synchronous and asynchronous stroking were not intermixed; they were separate blocks.
condition_intermixing.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, FBI manipulations and PPS measurement
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Exact trial-level randomization of PPS, baseline, and catch rows is not stated.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Synchronous and asynchronous visuo-tactile stroking were presented in separate blocks, with order counterbalanced between participants.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Front-space and back-space are separate experiments with different participants.

iti_jitter_policy.value: After a 60 s induction, three PPS task trials were given with 0.5 s between consecutive trials, followed by 10 s of FBI-only stroking; this cycle repeated until block end.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: No variable ITI/jitter distribution is reported beyond the fixed cycle.

response_window.evidence_note: Participants responded as fast as possible; RT trimming used 2.5 SD, but no numeric response timeout/scoring window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants pressed a gamepad button to vibrotactile targets and withheld responses on auditory-only catch trials while FBI stroking continued throughout each block.
task_sequence_rules.page_or_section: PDF p.3 PPS measurement and Procedure; supplement Procedure
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Questionnaire order was randomized, but that does not imply PPS trial order.

tactile_stimulus.value: Precision MicroDrives shaftless vibration motor model 312-101 delivered 100 ms vibrotactile stimulation at stern level: chest in Experiment 1 and back in Experiment 2.
tactile_stimulus.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-3, apparatus and PPS measurement
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Supplemental receding control used the same chest setup as Experiment 1.

soa_table.value: T1-T6 were 190, 380, 570, 760, 950, and 1140 ms after sound onset. For looming, T1-T6 map to D6-D1; distances are reported as 90, 75, 60, 45, 30, and 15 cm from body.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF p.3; supplement Peripersonal Space Measurement
soa_table.evidence_note: Receding control maps T1-T6 from D1 close to D6 far.

baseline_strategy.value: Baseline trials were unimodal tactile trials with no auditory stimulus at temporal equivalents of D1 or D6. Analyses compared audio-tactile RTs to each participant's fastest T1/T6 baseline averaged across synchrony.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.3 and 5, PPS measurement and baseline comparison
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Fastest-baseline correction is reported in the results analysis.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline tactile timing used the temporal equivalent of D1 or D6, corresponding to T6 or T1 for looming sounds; counts paragraph names T1 and T6 baseline delays.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: For receding control, T1 is close/D1 and T6 is far/D6.

catch_trial_type.value: Catch trials were auditory-only trials with no tactile stimulus, requiring participants to withhold response.
catch_trial_type.page_or_section: PDF p.3 PPS measurement; supplement PPS measurement
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch accuracy is reported for both main experiments.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Each stroking-condition block had 72 PPS experimental trials: 12 repetitions x 6 sound distances.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Counts are per block, and each block corresponds to one stroking condition.

baseline_count.value: Each stroking-condition block had 24 baseline trials: 12 repetitions x 2 baseline temporal delays T1 and T6.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Supplement phrases the same count as D1 and D6 for the receding control.

catch_count.value: Each stroking-condition block had 12 auditory-only catch trials.
catch_count.evidence_note: Catch count is explicitly listed with the block formula.

block_count.value: Each main experiment had two stroking-condition blocks per participant: synchronous and asynchronous, with order counterbalanced. The supplemental receding control used the same block logic.
block_count.page_or_section: PDF p.2 FBI manipulations; supplement Methods
block_count.evidence_note: Experiment 1 and Experiment 2 used separate participant samples.

total_trial_count.value: Per stroking block: 108 trials = 72 PPS + 24 baseline + 12 catch. Per participant per main experiment: 216 task trials across synchronous and asynchronous blocks.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Total is derived from the reported per-block formula and two stroking blocks.

critical_caveats: Exact sound waveform or class is not reported; the paper and supplement say looming/receding sound but not noise, tone, file, or generator.
No original audio files, sound-generation scripts, random seeds, or software provenance were found in the main paper or supplement.
No SPL, gain/cross-fade, speaker-switching, or attenuation law is reported for the dynamic loudspeaker-array presentation.
The exact speaker model and room acoustic calibration are not reported.
The task-critical sampled auditory interval is T1-T6 up to 1.14 s, but full sound-file duration/offset is not explicitly stated.
The supplement sound-localization control reports a 35 cm/s full front-to-back validation trajectory; the main PPS and receding-control tasks report 75 cm/s and should be kept separate.
No fixed numeric response timeout is reported; only fast-response instruction and 2.5 SD RT trimming are described.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence front/back FBI trunk PPS profile with a supplemental front-space receding control. Lab recreation needs explicit defaults for sound class, original asset substitute, speaker/gain law, SPL, full audio-file duration, and response timeout.
